bio: Angela Gonzales-Torres (born December 6, 1994) is an American community organizer and politician. A member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, she was a successful candidate in the 2026 election for California's 34th congressional district. She finished second in California's top-two primary and advanced to the general election against incumbent representative Jimmy Gomez, defeating him.
